name: spotify-player
local_adaptations: Keep Cargo caches/output inside the recipe (CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR under srcdir); fetch locked inputs in prepare and build/test frozen.
Declare alsa-lib as a check dependency: the default-features test build enables the rodio/cpal backend, whose alsa-sys crate requires ALSA headers.
Retain the official Arch feature set (pulseaudio-backend, media-control, notify, daemon, image, sixel, fzf) and runtime dependencies.
